document.abstract: Printing procedures and control techniques using an additive printer in the production of 16mm color positive prints from 16mm reversal color film are described. Matrix algebra is used in determining a basic exposure for each emulsion type and number used. These matrices can be used for initial printer calibration as well as for routine printer control.
